name: kits-projecthub
description: KITS ProjectHub — College project showcase for Kamala Institute of Technology and Science

scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "frontend,backend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
scripts.clean: cd frontend && npm run clean && cd ../backend && rm -rf dist
